blocks.title: Personal rights
blocks.text: Personal rights within terms of use include the right to privacy, the right to be informed and the right to withdraw consent. Users should know these rights and how to use them.

Under Pakistan's Personal Data Protection Bill users may access their data and ask for corrections or deletion, know how details such as addresses and phone numbers are used, and delete their account and data when they leave a platform.
